endpoint1.description: **Adaptive activity.** Cumulative new evolutionary activity (Bedau–Packard) with the threshold frozen per preset from a dedicated neutral-only calibration pilot ("calib-neutral", 20 runs per preset, seeds 1001–1020, 1,000,000 steps, census every 100, deep every 10), at the 95th percentile of pooled lineage activity (`tools/calibrate.ts`): gradient-m3: 10008; spots-m3: 14613. The analysed ensemble's own in-sample neutral 95th percentile is still reported by `tools/analyze.ts`, but only as a labelled diagnostic, never used for inference. Hypothesis: treatment > neutral and treatment > no-mutation (one-sided Mann–Whitney, α = 0.01 after Holm correction across the two comparisons).
